remarks: VRP Pricing- Seller will consider offers between $349,900 and $399,900.  Welcome home to this large and well maintained split-level home in Cheektowaga. It offers over 2,200 square feet of living space featuring a large living room, dining room and family room. There are four large bedrooms and 1.5 updated baths, along with numerous improvements throughout. The kitchen offers newly updated cabinets and Corian counters. The family room has a custom concrete floor, adding a unique and distinctive touch. Original hardwood enhances the living room, dining room and all bedrooms. Major updates include the kitchen, both bathrooms, siding, roof, and boiler system, providing peace of mind for the next owner. The new integrated boiler system delivers efficient home heating along with the convenience of on-demand tankless hot water. This home also features a huge first floor laundry room, a 3-season room and a full function hot tub leading to a beautifully landscaped yard for an inviting outdoor retreat. With its spacious layout, original hardwood character, extensive updates, and exceptional outdoor amenities, this Cheektowaga home offers a lot to love. Move-in ready and thoughtfully updated, this is one you won't want to miss!
